entries.text: Last week, I was at the grocery store.
Yesterday, I went to the library to return some books.
On Monday, I was working from home.
A few days ago, I was at my friend's house.
I picked up some fresh vegetables and fruits.
entries.translation: 我买了一些新鲜的蔬菜和水果。

translations.zh-Hans: 我买了一些新鲜的蔬菜和水果。

entries.text: It all started when I noticed my phone was missing.
entries.translation: 事情开始于我发现手机不见了。

translations.zh-Hans: 事情开始于我发现手机不见了。

entries.text: I decided to call my friend to catch up.
entries.translation: 我决定给朋友打电话聊聊近况。

translations.zh-Hans: 我决定给朋友打电话聊聊近况。

entries.text: Then, I realized I had left my wallet at home.
entries.translation: 然后，我意识到我把钱包忘在家里了。

translations.zh-Hans: 然后，我意识到我把钱包忘在家里了。

entries.text: Suddenly, it started to rain heavily.
The surprising part was I found an old friend there.
entries.translation: 令人惊讶的是，我在那里遇到了一个老朋友。

translations.zh-Hans: 令人惊讶的是，我在那里遇到了一个老朋友。

entries.text: I accidentally spilled coffee on my shirt.
entries.translation: 我不小心把咖啡洒在了衬衫上。

translations.zh-Hans: 我不小心把咖啡洒在了衬衫上。

entries.text: I forgot my umbrella and got soaked.
entries.translation: 我忘了带伞，结果淋湿了。

translations.zh-Hans: 我忘了带伞，结果淋湿了。

entries.text: Eventually, I managed to fix the problem myself.
entries.translation: 最终，我自己解决了这个问题。

translations.zh-Hans: 最终，我自己解决了这个问题。

entries.text: In the end, I felt relieved that everything worked out.
entries.translation: 最后，我感到很欣慰，一切都解决了。

translations.zh-Hans: 最后，我感到很欣慰，一切都解决了。

entries.text: I learned to always double-check my belongings.
entries.translation: 我学会了要时刻检查自己的物品。

translations.zh-Hans: 我学会了要时刻检查自己的物品。

entries.text: It taught me to be more prepared for surprises.
entries.translation: 这让我学会了更好地准备应对意外。

translations.zh-Hans: 这让我学会了更好地准备应对意外。
